decisions.reason: As a consumer-facing superfood product outside the firm’s main industrial technology focus, its brief website presence and disappearance suggest the option was tested, uncertainty largely resolved unfavorably, and resources are better redeployed to core sustainable process ventures.

Because this adjacent extension was only lightly presented and not developed into a stronger market-facing offer before disappearing, management would infer weak revealed demand and close the option rather than keep allocating attention to a marginal project.

Although strategically close to the core business and initially given dedicated promotion, its later absence indicates that enough information was learned about commercial traction or scalability to stop supporting it as a standalone product.

This near-core recycling technology was promising enough to receive its own page, but its subsequent disappearance points to unresolved economics or adoption barriers that make abandoning the option more sensible than continued commitment in a portfolio with many other ventures.
